name: header
title: Header
description: The top of every page: the brand, the main links, a phone number and one action. On a phone the links fold into a menu.

logo.label: Logo
logo.help: Shown instead of the square mark. Its alt text is the business name, so it may be left empty.

current.label: This page
current.help: Marks the link as the page being shown. On WordPress, kit Blocks works this out.

numbered.label: Number the links
numbered.help: Shows 01, 02… before each link. The numbers are decoration: screen readers hear the label alone.

tone.label: Background
tone.help: Plain uses the page's colours; dark is the inverse band, like the footer (the logo must read on it).
